header_comments: ConflictResolutionStrategy defines how conflicting policy decisions are resolved.
inline_comments: CandidateDecision pairs a matched rule with its resulting decision.
PolicyConflictResolver resolves conflicts between multiple matching rules.
Resolve returns a single PolicyDecision from a set of candidates using the configured strategy.
